comparators.name: SpiceDB
comparators.scope: Relationship authorization and per-request at_least_as_fresh / fully_consistent behaviour
comparators.consistency_profile: Use ZedToken at_least_as_fresh for matched read-after-write; separately report fully_consistent cache-bypass results

comparators.name: OpenFGA
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare matched HIGHER_CONSISTENCY and MINIMIZE_LATENCY query modes

comparators.name: Cedar
comparators.consistency_profile: Same policy/request semantics and context; do not compare unmatched policy expressiveness

comparators.name: OPA
comparators.consistency_profile: Same input corpus, policy distribution and cache conditions

comparators.name: AD DS / Entra ID / FreeIPA
comparators.scope: End-to-end enterprise lifecycle and incumbent integration
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare only equivalent service surfaces; report identity, session, group, recovery and administration paths separately

comparators.name: SPIRE / SPIFFE
comparators.scope: Workload identity issuance, rotation and trust-domain federation
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare shared workload identity responsibilities only

comparators.name: Holochain
comparators.consistency_profile: Exact conductor/HDK/HDI/Lair/Kitsune2 tuple and real conductors; report simulated peers separately

comparators.name: Cedar 4.6
comparators.scope: Policy decision semantics and policy evaluation errors
comparators.consistency_profile: Freeze policy set, schema and entity inputs; separately test policy-level skip-on-error vs required Mycelix authority-dependency closure; never let a mandatory missing identity/authority dependency become a skippable policy error

comparators.name: SCITT RFC 9943
comparators.scope: Signed decision-statement transparency and inclusion receipts
comparators.consistency_profile: Measure statement registration/inclusion/lookup and privacy; explicitly classify SCITT receipt as transparency evidence only, not truth, identity, permission or proof of downstream effect
